description: MCP Tasks (spec/command-metadata.md, "Tasks"; MCP 2026-07-28 SEP-2663) against a backend where todo-create-batch declares task: "optional". Each case names the client it needs: "tasks" declares the io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks capability on MCP 2026-07-28 and expects todo-create-batch to return a task polled via tasks/get to completion; "no-tasks" declares no tasks capability and expects todo-create-batch to run inline. For TypeScript, Python and Rust backends, dx/run-conformance.ts also runs post-completion retention and execution run-budget timeout checks against todo-slow-task (TASK_CONFORMANCE=1).

tests.name: afd-detail reports task: optional on todo-create-batch
tests.description: Discovery metadata advertises task: optional on todo-create-batch and omits task on todo-create

tests.name: Batch create runs as a task for a tasks-capable client
tests.description: todo-create-batch starts a task, polls tasks/get to completed, and persists the todos

tests.name: Non-task commands still run inline for a tasks-capable client
tests.description: todo-create has default task: never and executes inline even when the client declares tasks

tests.name: Batch create runs inline when client does not declare tasks
tests.description: todo-create-batch has task: optional so a client without io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks gets an inline result
